prompt:

ROW 1, all HAMILTON facing SOUTHEAST: three-quarter FRONT view looking diagonally toward the viewer and to the RIGHT, yaw halfway between full front and right profile (45 degrees). Columns 1 through 5: IDLE with feet planted; WALK left leg forward; WALK left passing/right heel lifted; WALK right leg forward; WALK right passing/left heel lifted. Columns 1 through 5: IDLE; WALK left leg forward; WALK passing; WALK right leg forward; WALK opposite passing. Coherent perspective of diagonal feet. Keep exactly the same body scale as row 1.

All sprites fully contained within cells, flat magenta separating every sprite.
